distribution.summary: 福建；江西；四川；西藏；云南；台湾
distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Fujian and Sichuan; 黄复生等 (2015) adds Yunnan and Xizang; Smith et al. (2020) confirms much of this range and adds Jiangxi and Taiwan.

host_note: Baseline hosts Castanopsis sp., Machilus sp., Castanopsis fargesii, and Castanopsis indica are retained; Smith et al. (2020) adds Cyclobalanopsis glauca and also reports Machilus at genus level.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Arixyleborus yakushimanus (Murayama, 1955).

taxonomic_history.name: Arixyleborus yakushimanus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The original combination is retained in the nomenclatural history; no additional synonyms are currently linked in the integrated backbone.
